offering_description.value: Sells consumer merchandise such as home goods, apparel, beauty, jewelry and electronics through live and recorded television shopping programs, websites, mobile apps and social media. Operates QVC and HSN brands, with products sourced from vendors and private labels, delivered from company fulfillment centers.

primary_products.value: home goods; apparel and accessories; beauty products; jewelry; consumer electronics

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers shopping via TV, web, apps and social media

end_markets.value: consumer retail; home; fashion and accessories; beauty; jewelry

revenue_model.value: product sales: merchandise sold to consumers via video commerce and e-commerce

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys merchandise from vendors and private-label sources, sells to consumers via TV and digital; brand owner: private label products made by contract manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: US, UK, Germany, Italy, Japan and other markets

specialization.value: related lines: QVC and HSN video commerce plus home and lifestyle brands, all consumer retail

distribution_channels.value: online: websites, mobile apps, streaming and social media; direct sales: television shopping programs with phone ordering; own locations: outlet stores

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer protection, advertising, product safety and data privacy rules, FTC and FCC oversight

notes: Company structure after recent changes (e.g., Cornerstone status) is uncertain.
